gallerySource.endpoints: outer eave-column axis to inner enclosure axis
gallerySource.limitation: Two views in the same 2005 report, not independent as-built surveys. Exhibition insert is excluded. No exact clear width or 2026 access claim.

publicAccess.note: Architectural preview openings do not assert visitor permission. Raised plinth/stair elevations remain deferred.

body.basis: Solve actual lower skirt eave equation; preserve existing beam proportion as labelled approximation.

provenance.registration: 2005 report p114: 435 graphical pixels registered provisionally to published 25m depth; crop floor y584 anchored to retained model floor 12.3. Isotropic reproduction assumed; not a measured height.
provenance.materialInterpretation: Wood/caihua/dougong are provisional exterior material labels, not identifications from monochrome section lines. Source y399 is an internal partition; lower visible layer continues to y412–414.
provenance.absoluteHeight: Retained floor datum and ornament morphology do not verify total height. Official tourism 37.95m and older Museum 35m+ have unresolved endpoints/baselines; tile ridge and actual ornament bounds are distinct.

horizontalGrid.omitted: Concealed intermediate gable columns and full-height timber/joinery are not reconstructed.

innerAxis.endpoints: centre axis to inner main-column axis
innerAxis.registration: 2005 p114 section: outer axes ~67/501 and inner axes ~229/340 in the private section crop; 434 px registered to 25 m gives ~3.20 m. p124 plan and 2021 plan confirm six-row topology.

facade.adoption: Nine independently framed bays per face; retained central preview doors only. Exact leaf counts, door/window distinction and current opening state remain unknown.
facade.bayNumbering: increasing model X (geographic east to west)

interior.visibleScope: Retained provisional floor/ceiling, recessed enclosure and source-bounded column rows only; not a historic interior or current exhibition reconstruction.
